description:
Nostalgia Critic takes a look at the film inspired by a now nostalgic game. Does he agree with the critics or think the film got crapped on too much? Nostalgia-Ween continues with Five Nights at Freddy's.

Five Nights at Freddy's is a 2023 American supernatural horror film based on the video game series of the same name created by Scott Cawthon. It was directed by Emma Tammi, written by Cawthon, Tammi and Seth Cuddeback, and produced by Jason Blum and Cawthon. The film stars Josh Hutcherson as a troubled security guard who starts a job at an unsafe abandoned pizzeria,
title: Five Nights at Freddy's - Nostalgia Critic
